description: A Senior Backend Engineer search (6+ yrs) where the distinguishing signal is the experience floor, not level. Several candidates read as level-aligned or unclear but their dated roles fall short of 6 years. Isolates the below_experience_floor branch, and confirms experience_floor==None (unknown) never gates.
rules: DRAFT: experience_floor False -> exclude; experience_floor None (unknown) -> admit; level unclear/aligned -> admit.

candidates.ref: Senior Engineer by title but only 4 dated years
